summary: Sandbach United fielded an unchanged side against New Mills in a competitive encounter at Hind Heath Road, looking to build on their narrow victory over Stafford Town on Saturday. The match remained goalless through 25 minutes with chances at both ends, including a good save from keeper Hall and a Sandbach volley from Saul that the New Mills goalkeeper pushed wide. The Bach will be hoping to secure back-to-back home wins as they continue their campaign in what proved to be challenging conditions.
